other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must be a registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka.
The accident must occur either during the course of employment or outside of work.
benefits_summary: Provides monetary compensation for death (₹5 lakhs), permanent total disablement (₹2 lakhs) and permanent partial disablement (₹1 lakhs) to eligible workers.
